name: ctxwise
description: CtxWise: local-first context diagnostics, budget guards, profiles, drift detection, and honest usage receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Measure and guard Codex context locally
interface.longDescription: Get an immediate local context snapshot, enforce reviewable context budgets, audit Codex sources, compile safe profiles, detect capability drift, create redacted lockfiles, and render post-turn usage receipts without sending data to another service. Distinct from the unrelated PyPI project named ctxray.
defaultPrompt: Show my immediate Codex context snapshot with CtxWise.
Check my CtxWise context budget before a task.
Create a lean Codex profile with CtxWise.
